title: SC2_SND_REMIX
body:
### **SC2_SND_REMIX**

Tried my best to make **Scorched Guns 2** feel a lot juicier and terrifying when coupled with **Sound Physics Remastered / Perfected**, butchering sounds in a way that feels fair to me in respect to every gun. 

Goes well with **"Scorched Guns 2 Reanimated"** resource pack by **"ordinarymid"**. 

Almost every fire sound was replaced, all sounds are in stereo now too. Using this in horror-adventure environments results in a **"Predator"** minigun spray & pray scenarios. Enjoy.
